{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOQ7BKhc8AAAABXGOaaA", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4Bm6sGzhAqF5A", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4Bm6sG", "number": 11, "title": "Upgrade Three.js to latest stable and validate Draft v2.0 plugins before npm publish", "body": "## Problem

The Draft v2.0 loader/exporter integration tests and demo currently use Three.js **r182** (`three: ^0.182.0` and `@types/three: ^0.182.0` in the loader, exporter, and demo packages). The latest Three.js release confirmed on 2026-10-14 is **r186** (published 2026-09-24).

Before manually publishing the updated loader/exporter packages to npm, verify them against the latest Three.js instead of relying only on r182 tests. This is a dependency-upgrade and compatibility-validation task, **not** an npm publishing task.

## Expected outcome

- Update the Three.js dependency used by the **loader**, **exporter**, and **demo/test suite** to the latest stable release (r186 at issue creation; re-check the latest stable release when implementing).
- Update matching `@types/three`, lockfiles, and any affected test/demo configuration consistently.
- Do not just modify `package.json`: actually install the new dependencies and run the real Draft v2.0 loader/exporter integration tests against the updated Three.js version.
- Fix compatibility problems in the existing plugins or test fixtures if a Three.js API or behavior change requires it. Keep the implementation focused and preserve Draft v2.0 semantics.
- Update documentation that still says the supported/tested Three.js baseline is r182; state accurately which release was **actually tested**.
- Review the library `peerDependencies` lower bound separately: do not claim that earlier Three.js releases are supported or unsupported without evidence. Do not add version-compatibility shims solely for Draft v1.0 (v1.0 remains unsupported).
- Do **not** publish packages to npm as part of this issue; prepare and report the verified state for a later manual `npm publish`.

## Context

- [Three.js latest GitHub release](https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/releases/latest) — r186 when this issue was created.
- [Demo test suite](https://github.com/takahirox/THREE_materials_tsl/blob/main/packages/demo/test/roundtrip.test.js) — the existing 70 integration tests.
- [Loader package](https://github.com/takahirox/THREE_materials_tsl/blob/main/packages/loader/package.json)
- [Exporter package](https://github.com/takahirox/THREE_materials_tsl/blob/main/packages/exporter/package.json)
- [Demo package](https://github.com/takahirox/THREE_materials_tsl/blob/main/packages/demo/package.json)
- Related: #9 and merged PR #10 implemented Draft v2.0 with tests initially targeting r182.

## Pre-merge acceptance

- [ ] Record the latest stable Three.js release used and the resolved installed version in the test report.
- [ ] Update dependencies and checked-in lockfiles in all three packages; `npm ci` succeeds from a clean state.
- [ ] `npm --prefix packages/demo test` succeeds against the updated Three.js (70 existing tests, plus any necessary regression tests for discovered incompatibilities).
- [ ] `npm --prefix packages/loader run build` succeeds.
- [ ] `npm --prefix packages/exporter run build` succeeds.
- [ ] `npm --prefix packages/demo run build` succeeds, and the demo TypeScript typecheck passes.
- [ ] Validate v2.0 `materialType`, ordinary glTF material properties, dynamic `materialColor`, `KHR_materials_*` behavior, repeated round trips, and atomic fallback through the existing integration suite.
- [ ] Update README claims about tested versions and any relevant compatibility limitations.
- [ ] Confirm no Draft v1.0 compatibility path is reintroduced.
- [ ] Run `git diff --check`; report test/build results and any skipped optional browser/WebGPU rendering checks.

## Optional validation

Browser/WebGPU visual smoke test of the demo when the required environment is available; report separately if not performed. Inspect dependency audit findings separately rather than conflating them with Three.js compatibility.

## Required post-merge verification
